item_name: Rothco Pepper Spray Holder / Large - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Large Pepper Spray Holder is made with durable polyester material with hook and loop closure, made to fit around a duty belt. The pepper spray holder measures 5 ¼” x 1 ¼” closed. The holder is easily accessible and always close at hand when kept attached to a duty belt, ideal for any law enforcement official carrying pepper spray.
